status: Confirmed purchasing-policy supplement for preliminary BOM analysis. Does not change supplier prices, quantities, installed masses or candidate selections. Not budget-compliance verification, procurement authorization or PDR/CDR acceptance.

requires.reason: Revision 2 validates and consumes policy_confirmations. Apply this supplement after the supplier supplements. Original files remain unchanged.

policy_confirmations.source_quote: The proposal also charged the vehicle budget for whole minimum purchase packs/spools, including the mandatory two-battery pack even though only one battery flies; do not assume any equipment is already owned.
policy_confirmations.application: Charge whole minimum purchasable packs, spools and stock lengths to the vehicle budget, including the full mandatory two-battery pack. Count only installed quantities in flight mass. No ownership credits or prorated stock costs.

policy_confirmations.source_quote: Recovery for the latest human reply, 'Yes I agree with your proposal': the question was whether reusable ground equipment should be priced separately from the AUD 500 vehicle cap.
policy_confirmations.application: Itemize and price required reusable ground equipment separately from the strictly less than AUD 500 vehicle hardware/material cap. Assume no equipment is owned. This confirms the accounting category, not the completeness or classification of the historical excluded_gse list. Tax and shipping remain excluded under REQ-HARDWARE-BUDGET revision 4.

open_items.description: The inspected revision-2 calculator hardcodes requirement revision 3 in verification scope and retains static limitation text calling the purchasing policies unconfirmed. Prepare a new sandbox copy with current reporting before claiming revision-4 verification; preserve historical inputs and script. The merger also retains historical requirement revisions, which must not be presented as concurrent current requirements.

Policy confirmation does not enforce pack arithmetic. Audit explicit purchase-unit quantities, minimum orders, installed quantities and installed mass for every selected line. The current line_mass function multiplies the same quantity field used for purchasing by unit_mass_kg; verify battery packs, stock materials and spares without silently equating purchased quantity with installed quantity.

Establish a separately priced complete reusable-GSE schedule with dated supplier evidence, currency and units. An excluded_gse list alone does not establish its cost or completeness; ambiguous vehicle consumables and hardware cannot silently be excluded.
